notes: Topic graphs per track. `prereqs` must point to earlier topics of the same track. `keywords` are lowercase words/phrases used to map book chapters to topics (chapter titles + full-text density). `bookTags` limit which books are searched (matched against books.json topics).

topics.label: Algorithm analysis & Big-O
topics.description: Order of growth, worst/average case, amortized cost, comparing algorithms by running time and memory.

topics.label: Arrays, lists, stacks & queues
topics.description: Arrays vs. linked lists, resizing arrays, stacks, queues and their costs.

topics.label: Recursion & divide-and-conquer
topics.description: Base cases, recursion trees, recurrences, splitting problems into subproblems.

topics.label: Sorting & priority queues
topics.description: Insertion sort, mergesort, quicksort, heapsort, stability, lower bounds, binary heaps.

topics.label: Hash tables & symbol tables
topics.description: Symbol table API, hash functions, separate chaining, linear probing, load factor.

topics.label: Search trees
topics.description: Binary search trees, balanced trees (2-3, red-black, B-trees), ordered operations.

topics.label: Graph algorithms
topics.description: Graph representations, BFS/DFS, topological sort, shortest paths, minimum spanning trees.

topics.label: Dynamic programming & greedy
topics.description: Optimal substructure, overlapping subproblems, memoization, greedy choice.

topics.label: Bits, integers & floating point
topics.description: Binary representation, two's complement, overflow, byte order, IEEE floating point.

topics.label: Caches & the memory hierarchy
topics.description: Locality, cache lines, hits and misses, writing cache-friendly code.

topics.label: Processes & scheduling
topics.description: Processes, context switches, system calls, signals, CPU scheduling.

topics.label: Memory management & virtual memory
topics.description: Address spaces, paging, page tables, TLBs, page replacement, heap allocation.

topics.label: Threads, synchronization & deadlock
topics.description: Threads, race conditions, mutexes, semaphores, condition variables, deadlock.

topics.label: Files, storage & I/O
topics.description: File descriptors, buffered I/O, file-system structure, disks and SSDs.

topics.label: Network programming basics
topics.description: Client-server model, sockets, TCP/IP, HTTP basics.

topics.label: Object-oriented design principles
topics.description: Encapsulation, inheritance vs. composition, polymorphism, programming to interfaces, SOLID.

topics.label: Design patterns
topics.description: Strategy, Observer, Decorator, Factory, Singleton, Command, Adapter, Facade, Template Method, Iterator, Composite, State, Proxy.

topics.label: Code quality & pragmatic practice
topics.description: Readable code, naming, DRY, orthogonality, testing, debugging, refactoring.

topics.label: JavaScript core
topics.description: Scope, closures, prototypes, `this`, classes and modules of the language itself.

topics.label: The Node.js event loop
topics.description: Non-blocking I/O, the reactor pattern, libuv, the event demultiplexer, blocking the loop.

topics.label: Callbacks & EventEmitter
topics.description: Continuation-passing style, error-first callbacks, sync vs. async APIs (Zalgo), EventEmitter.

topics.label: Promises & async/await
topics.description: Promise states and chaining, error propagation, async/await, unhandled rejections.

topics.label: Asynchronous control flow
topics.description: Sequential and parallel execution, limited concurrency, race conditions, task queues.

topics.label: Module systems
topics.description: CommonJS vs. ES modules, resolution, caching, cycles, module patterns.

topics.label: Streams & backpressure
topics.description: Readable/Writable/Transform streams, piping, backpressure, stream composition.

topics.label: Design patterns in Node.js
topics.description: Factory, builder, revealing constructor, proxy, decorator, adapter, strategy, middleware, dependency injection.

topics.label: Scaling & distributed Node
topics.description: Cluster module, load balancing, worker threads, microservices, messaging and queues.

topics.label: C pointers, arrays & declarations
topics.description: Pointer arithmetic, arrays vs. pointers, reading complex declarations, undefined behaviour.

topics.label: Classes & object lifetime
topics.description: Constructors, destructors, copy constructor/assignment, rule of three/five, const correctness.

topics.label: Resource management, RAII & smart pointers
topics.description: RAII, new/delete, unique_ptr, shared_ptr, ownership, leaks.

topics.label: Move semantics
topics.description: Value categories, rvalue references, move constructors, std::move, perfect forwarding.

topics.label: Inheritance & virtual functions
topics.description: Public inheritance, virtual dispatch, vtables, virtual destructors, abstract classes, slicing.

topics.label: Templates & generic programming
topics.description: Function and class templates, specialization, type deduction, traits.

topics.label: STL containers
topics.description: vector, deque, list, map, set, unordered containers; complexity and iterator invalidation.

topics.label: Iterators, algorithms & function objects

topics.label: Exceptions & error handling

topics.label: C++ concurrency

topics.label: Modern C++ (11/14/17)

topics.label: Python core
topics.description: Built-in types, lists/dicts/tuples, functions, scopes, mutability.

topics.label: Python classes & OOP
topics.description: Classes, instances, inheritance, special methods, properties.

topics.label: Iterators, generators & decorators
topics.description: Iteration protocol, generators, comprehensions, decorators, context managers.

topics.label: NumPy arrays & vectorization
topics.description: ndarray, dtypes, broadcasting, vectorized operations, views vs. copies.

topics.label: pandas data wrangling
topics.description: Series/DataFrame, indexing, missing data, groupby, merge/join, reshaping.

topics.label: Probability & statistics
topics.description: Random variables, distributions, expectation, variance, Bayes' rule, likelihood.

topics.label: Linear algebra for ML

topics.label: Supervised learning fundamentals
topics.description: Training/test split, loss, overfitting, bias-variance, cross-validation, evaluation metrics.

topics.label: Decision trees & ensembles

topics.label: Clustering & dimensionality reduction
topics.description: k-means, mixture models and EM, PCA.

topics.description: Perceptron, multilayer networks, activation functions, backpropagation.
